entities.summary: Botswana is a sovereign nation in Southern Africa, Africa. Its capital is Gaborone. Official languages include English. Government: Unitary parliamentary constitutional republic. Population: approximately 2.6 million. Area: 581,730 km². Comprehensive index for Botswana covering San/Bushmen (oldest continuous inhabitants), Tswana kingdoms, Bechuanaland protectorate, Seretse Khama interracial marriage controversy, independence 1966, diamond economy (Debswana), and Africa's democratic success story with highest HDI growth.
